title: When Attention Becomes Exposure in Generative Search

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing generative search engine citation panels using enterprise-specific queries to measure the citation frequency and rank of prominent creators. The study compares the exposure of Top-10 creators against lower-ranked ones using Top-10 exposure advantage and Normalized Cumulative Gain (NCG), and uses OLS regression to correlate citation rank with follower counts and community concentration.
